blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks edged higher on Tuesday as bargain hunting pushed the benchmark index above the 5,800 resistance level, while GCash parent Mynt Inc. ended its market debut flat. The Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) rose 0.14 percent, or 8.27 points, to close at 5,806.17. READ: It’s official: GCash parent Mynt makes PSE debut Investors continued to pick up bargain stocks, helping the market finish in positive territory after moving sideways during the session, according to Philstocks Financial Inc.
